champion.scope: The source's put mode, trigger presence, and channel are inferred by simulating all 18 family members against calibration receipts; only members matching every receipt are retained. The goal is resolved only if all retained members predict the same value.
champion.lesson: Calibration receipts uniquely constrain the family member when they include discriminating cases like repeated puts, updates, deletes, and cross-connection writes. The channel is not net committed effects: changes() reflects the last statement's direct row changes plus trigger changes, while total_changes accumulates across statements and connections.

champion.scope: Enumerates the 18-member family (3 put ops x 3 channels x 2 trigger states), filters by all calibration receipts, and predicts channel/committed_count/committed_sum only when every surviving member agrees.
champion.lesson: The channel is main total_changes plus other total_changes, the put operation is INSERT OR REPLACE, and there is an AFTER INSERT trigger that logs one row per insert. The committed state is the final state after all actions, with uncommitted transactions discarded. The channel counts every row change including those in uncommitted transactions and trigger inserts.
